name: Scooter
summary: One foot on the platform, the other on the carriage. Push the carriage back from the hip.
steps: Stand beside the reformer near the footbar, inside foot on the floor next to the carriage.
Other foot against the nearest shoulder rest; standing knee bent, chest tipped slightly forward.
Breathe out to push the carriage back by straightening the carriage leg.
Breathe in to bend it back in.

layers.title: One or both hands behind the back
Front heel lifted
layers.text: Lift the standing heel, or put a small ball under it.

layers.title: Raised
layers.text: Standing foot on a box or platform.

modifications: Pregnancy: a lighter spring and both hands on the bar.

cautions.note: Bent-knee weight bearing; keep range small.
Single-leg balance; keep a hand on the footbar.

cues:
Hips stay square to the footbar.
Weight back in the standing heel, shin upright.
Standing knee over the middle toes.
The standing leg doesn't bob up and down.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
